MY CONTRIBUTION

The work between
the drawing and the site.

01 / DRAWINGS

Prepare and clarify.

I prepared working and coordination drawings for residential, commercial, and interior projects, and worked with the project team to clarify drawing and site questions.

  • Construction documentation
  • Working and coordination drawings
  • Constructability coordination
02 / FIELD REVIEWS

Review what is being built.

My site visits focused on progress, workmanship, materials, and conformance with project drawings. Material selection and quantity review supported those conversations.

  • Progress and workmanship reviews
  • Materials and drawing conformance
  • Material selection and quantity review
03 / COORDINATION

Connect the people and work.

I coordinated with site managers, contractors, consultants, and vendors on materials, work sequencing, and constructability issues during execution.

  • Drawing and site questions
  • Material coordination
  • Work sequencing

COORDINATION FOCUS

Keeping the details
connected to execution.

My focus was the connection between drawings, material decisions, and site conditions. Preparing documentation was one part of the work; reviewing it with the people executing construction was the other.

This experience is the foundation I bring to a Project/Field Engineer or Assistant Project Manager role, alongside my current construction management studies at Arizona State University.
